+import collections
+import functools
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class QwenTokens:
+    def __init__(self):
+        tokenizer = json.loads(Path('/workspace/model/tokenizer.json').read_text())
+        self.vocab = tokenizer['model']['vocab']
+        added = tokenizer['added_tokens']
+        self.special = {item['content']: item['id'] for item in added}
+        self.special_split = re.compile('(' + '|'.join(map(re.escape, self.special)) + ')')
+        self.merges = {tuple(merge if isinstance(merge, list) else merge.split(' ')): rank
+                       for rank, merge in enumerate(tokenizer['model']['merges'])}
+        plain = list(range(33, 127)) + list(range(161, 173)) + list(range(174, 256))
+        byte_values = plain + [byte for byte in range(256) if byte not in plain]
+        codepoints = plain + list(range(256, 256 + 256 - len(plain)))
+        self.byte_to_char = {byte: chr(point) for byte, point in zip(byte_values, codepoints)}
+        self.char_to_byte = {char: byte for byte, char in self.byte_to_char.items()}
+        self.pieces = {index: piece for piece, index in self.vocab.items()}
+        self.special_by_index = {index: piece for piece, index in self.special.items()}
+        ranges = {category: [] for category in ('L', 'M', 'N')}
+        for point in range(0x110000):
+            category = unicodedata.category(chr(point))[0]
+            if category in ranges:
+                group = ranges[category]
+                if group and group[-1][1] == point - 1:
+                    group[-1][1] = point
+                else:
+                    group.append([point, point])
+        pretokenizer = tokenizer['pre_tokenizer']['pretokenizers'][0]['pattern']['Regex']
+        for category, group in ranges.items():
+            pretokenizer = pretokenizer.replace(r'\p{' + category + '}', ''.join(
+                chr(first) if first == last else chr(first) + '-' + chr(last)
+                for first, last in group
+            ))
+        self.split_pieces = re.compile(pretokenizer)
+
+    @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=32768)
+    def _piece_ids(self, piece):
+        atoms = [self.byte_to_char[byte] for byte in piece.encode('utf-8')]
+        while len(atoms) > 1:
+            pairs = list(zip(atoms, atoms[1:]))
+            best = min(pairs, key=lambda pair: self.merges.get(pair, len(self.merges)))
+            if best not in self.merges:
+                break
+            merged = []
+            index = 0
+            while index < len(atoms):
+                if index + 1 < len(atoms) and (atoms[index], atoms[index + 1]) == best:
+                    merged.append(atoms[index] + atoms[index + 1])
+                    index += 2
+                else:
+                    merged.append(atoms[index])
+                    index += 1
+            atoms = merged
+        return tuple(self.vocab[atom] for atom in atoms)
+
+    def encode(self, text):
+        result = []
+        for chunk in self.special_split.split(unicodedata.normalize('NFC', text)):
+            if chunk in self.special:
+                result.append(self.special[chunk])
+            else:
+                for match in self.split_pieces.finditer(chunk):
+                    result.extend(self._piece_ids(match[0]))
+        return result
+
+    @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=32768)
+    def piece(self, index):
+        if index in self.special_by_index:
+            return self.special_by_index[index]
+        return bytes(self.char_to_byte[char] for char in self.pieces[index]).decode('utf-8', 'replace')
+
+    def text_pieces(self, text):
+        return [self.piece(index) for index in self.encode(text)]
+
+
+def generations(run):
+    return json.loads(Path(f'gen/{run}.json').read_text())
+
+
+def boxes(text):
+    for match in re.finditer(r'\\boxed\s*\{', text):
+        depth = 1
+        for stop in range(match.end(), len(text)):
+            marker = text[stop]
+            depth += (marker == '{') - (marker == '}')
+            if depth == 0:
+                value = text[match.end():stop].strip()
+                if value:
+                    yield value
+                break
+
+
+def report_generation(run, tokenizer):
+    for index, item in enumerate(generations(run)):
+        chunks = tokenizer.text_pieces(item['reply'])
+        run_counts = collections.Counter(tuple(chunks[pos:pos + 12])
+                                         for pos in range(len(chunks) - 11))
+        max_repeat = max(run_counts.values(), default=0)
+        wait_count = sum(chunk.strip() == 'Wait' for chunk in chunks)
+        close = chunks.index('</think>') if '</think>' in chunks else '-'
+        final = item['reply'].split('</think>')[-1]
+        alternatives = list(boxes(final))
+        print(f'{run}:{index:02} {item["finish_reason"]:<6} {item["tokens"]:5d} '
+              f'waits={wait_count:3d} repeat12={max_repeat:3d} close={str(close):>4s} '
+              f'box={alternatives[-2:]}')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    import sys
+
+    tokenizer = QwenTokens()
+    for run in map(int, sys.argv[1:]):
+        report_generation(run, tokenizer)
